groups.canonical_name: Right to repair data security exposure
groups.definition: Right to repair laws could require third-party access to vehicle data and systems, creating security and operational risks.
Expanding global data privacy and AI rules such as GDPR and CCPA impose rising compliance costs and penalty exposure.

groups.canonical_name: Fuel economy and emissions compliance costs
groups.definition: Stricter fuel economy and greenhouse gas rules, and alleged violations, could limit profitable vehicle sales and impose credit purchases, fines, recalls or added costs.
Compliance with a wide range of international, national and local laws is costly, and government inquiries could lead to enforcement actions or fines.
Environmental rules may require abatement equipment, elimination of materials or processes, or emissions fees, raising manufacturing costs.
